name: Taskade
description_en:
Taskade is a workspace that combines structured projects with AI agents, trigger-based automations and hosted apps built through Taskade Genesis. Its current product is broader than a personal to-do list: project data can feed agents and workflows, while a generated interface exposes selected functionality to app users.

Projects still provide task and note planning in multiple views of the same data. The important evaluation question is which work should stay a human-reviewed project update and which should execute as an external action. This profile covers that boundary, permissions, usage costs and app export/recovery; it does not claim an app, agent or workflow was run.
description_zh:
Taskade 把结构化项目、AI Agent、触发式自动化及经 Taskade Genesis 构建的托管应用组合在工作区。当前产品范围超出个人待办：项目数据可供 Agent 与流程使用，生成界面则向应用用户开放所选功能。

项目仍可通过多视图规划任务和笔记，各视图使用同一数据。评估重点是哪些工作应保留为人工复核的项目更新，哪些应执行为外部动作。本档案覆盖该边界、权限、用量成本及应用导出／恢复，没有声称运行过应用、Agent 或流程。

core_features.explanation_en: List, Board, Table and other views edit the same underlying project.
core_features.explanation_zh: List、Board、Table 等视图编辑同一底层项目。

core_features.explanation_en: Workflows connect triggers/actions to project context with per-run inspection.
core_features.explanation_zh: 流程把触发／动作与项目上下文连接，并可逐次检查。

core_features.explanation_en: Paid export carries app structures, projects, agents and automations with explicit omissions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 付费导出包含应用结构、项目、Agent 和自动化，但有明确排除项。

en: Prototype an internal request board, let an agent propose categorization, and review outcomes before enabling notifications to an external system.
zh: 试作内部请求看板，让 Agent 建议分类，复核结果后再启用外部系统通知。
use_cases.basis: Hypothetical evaluation, not a deployed app or tested external operation.

Runtime.en: Hosted workspace/apps and server-side workflows; browser, desktop and mobile access advertised. Exported app artifacts do not establish a self-hosted copy of the whole platform.
Runtime.zh: 托管工作区／应用及服务端流程；宣传提供浏览器、桌面和移动访问。导出应用产物不确立整个平台的自行托管副本。

specific_roles: Small team combining project data with automation

steps.en: Start with harmless project data; select roles, view and measurable task acceptance before generating an app.
steps.zh: 先用无害项目数据，确定角色、视图及可衡量任务验收后再生成应用。

steps.en: Inspect credits, triggers, external write permissions and bundle import activation before testing one workflow.
steps.zh: 测试一个流程前，检查积分、触发器、外部写入权限及应用包导入自动启用。

integrations.scope: Connector triggers/actions are documented; bidirectional means available incoming/outgoing operations, not guaranteed arbitrary field synchronization. Inbound hosted MCP differs from outbound connector use.

items.en: Viewer can comment and Editor can invite; project overrides and external app users need separate review.
items.zh: Viewer 可评论、Editor 可邀请；项目覆盖权限与外部应用用户需分别复核。

items.en: Import can activate automations; domains, secrets and app-user accounts are not restored by an app bundle.
items.zh: 导入可启用自动化；域名、secret 及应用用户账户不由应用包恢复。

license.scope: User-content ownership and generated-app exports differ from proprietary platform rights and public App Kit licenses.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free$0; Pro$20monthly or$120/year, Business$50or$300/year, Max$200or$1200/year, Enterprise$500or$3000/year. Rates cover included members, not each seat. Usage packs/provider fees may add cost; currency/tax/checkout unverified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free $0；Pro 月付 $20 或年付 $120，Business $50／$300，Max $200／$1200，Enterprise $500／$3000。费率覆盖所含成员，不逐席位收费。用量包／模型方费用可能另计；币种／税／结账未核实。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: Keep project data distinct from the app built around it
sections.title_zh: 区分项目数据与围绕数据构建的应用
sections.en:
For a proposed request tracker, store a request, owner, next action and due date in a project. Inspect that same record as a Board and Table before generating a portal around it. Views reshape the same data; they do not create separate copies. Some advanced views are paid and Docs is labeled beta.

An agent suggestion or published dashboard does not prove a request was resolved. Retain an observable acceptance condition and identify the authoritative record. A team needing only shared tasks may not need app-building and automation complexity; a prototype with external users additionally needs access and data-handling decisions.
sections.zh:
假设构建请求跟踪器，可在项目保存请求、负责人、下一动作及到期日。先用 Board 和 Table 查看同一记录，再围绕它生成门户。视图重塑同一数据，不产生独立副本。部分进阶视图付费，Docs 标为 beta。

Agent 建议或已发布仪表板不证明请求已解决。应保留可观察验收条件及明确权威记录。只需要共享任务的团队未必需要应用构建及自动化复杂度；面向外部用户的原型还需决定访问及数据处理。

sections.title_en: Workspace, project and app users are different audiences
sections.title_zh: 工作区、项目及应用用户是不同人群
sections.en:
The role matrix allows Editors to invite members and run agents/automations; Maintainers also control billing and roles. Viewers may comment. Project permissions can override the workspace baseline, and external users of a published app are managed separately. A label such as Viewer is therefore insufficient on its own to predict every operation.

Project public links, editor links and account invitations are also different paths. Decide which person needs to build, review or simply use the published app. Test harmless records through each intended path; do not assume a portal sign-in automatically restricts every backend project or connector.
sections.zh:
角色矩阵允许 Editor 邀请成员及运行 Agent／自动化；Maintainer 还可管理计费及角色，Viewer 可评论。项目权限可覆盖工作区基线，已发布应用的外部用户另行管理。因此仅凭 Viewer 等标签不足以预测每项操作。

项目公开链接、编辑链接及账户邀请也是不同路径。应确定谁需构建、复核，谁仅使用已发布应用，并用无害记录逐一测试。不能假设门户登录会自动限制全部后端项目或连接器。

sections.title_en: Inspect the failed step before replaying a workflow
sections.title_zh: 重放流程前检查失败步骤
sections.en:
Automations run server-side. History exposes step inputs, outputs and errors; transient network, rate-limit and server failures are documented to retry with backoff. After five consecutive failed runs, Taskade disables the automation and emails workspace owners. Fixing a credential or missing field is a different operation from replaying a run.

For a proposed intake flow, begin with categorization and a test destination. Before retrying a real notification, check whether an earlier step already sent it. The availability of incoming triggers and outgoing actions is not proof of exactly-once processing, universal synchronization, rollback or safe duplication handling. Those require a workflow-specific test.
sections.zh:
自动化在服务端运行。History 显示步骤输入、输出及错误；文档称临时网络、限流及服务端故障会退避重试。连续五次运行失败后，Taskade 会停用自动化并邮件通知工作区所有者。修正凭据或缺字段与重放运行是不同操作。

假设接收请求流程，应先使用分类和测试目标。重试真实通知前，检查前一步是否已发送。存在输入触发器和输出动作，不证明恰好一次处理、通用同步、回滚或安全去重；这些需针对具体流程测试。

sections.title_en: Budget the workspace, automation runs and model work
sections.title_zh: 预算应覆盖工作区、流程运行及模型工作
sections.en:
Pro includes ten people; Business and above advertise unlimited people. Free includes two people, three live apps and ten monthly automation runs, but starts without AI credits. Paid plans include recurring monthly credit allowances. Prices are workspace totals up to those member limits, not a per-person multiplication.

Pro is $20 monthly or $120/year; Business $50 or $300/year; Max $200 or $1,200/year; Enterprise $500 or $3,000/year. Included run/credit limits differ. Monthly credits reset and are used before nonexpiring Extra Credits. A published app’s free visitor runtime does not settle the cost of its separate agent work or automation usage. Inspect the actual credit picker, run allowance and auto-top-up settings before budgeting a production workflow.
sections.zh:
Pro 包含十人，Business 及以上宣传不限人数。免费层含两人、三个在线应用及每月十次自动化，但初始没有 AI 积分。付费层包含每月积分额度；价格覆盖成员上限内整个工作区，不按人数相乘。

Pro 月付 $20 或年付 $120；Business $50／$300；Max $200／$1,200；Enterprise $500／$3,000。各层运行／积分限制不同。每月积分重置，先于不过期 Extra Credits 使用。已发布应用的访客运行免费，不确立其独立 Agent 工作或自动化用量免费。预算生产流程前，应核对实际积分选择器、运行额度及自动充值设置。

sections.title_en: An owned model key does not remove every Taskade charge
sections.title_zh: 自备模型 key 不会移除全部 Taskade 费用
sections.en:
The BYOK guide separates surfaces: eligible signed-in agent chats can use the provider account without Taskade credits, while subscription AI automation steps retain a fixed ten-credit step fee. EVE app building still uses Taskade credits. A default fallback can spend Taskade credits if a key fails; public agents and automation paths have narrower rules.

Choose a specific model and inspect both provider and Taskade usage before switching a workload. A no-training contract described in the privacy policy is a processing condition, not proof content stays on-device or that model output is accurate. No provider key was created, saved, tested or transmitted during this research.
sections.zh:
BYOK 指南区分使用面：符合条件的已登录 Agent 聊天可使用模型账户而不耗 Taskade 积分，订阅方案的 AI 自动化步骤仍固定收十积分；EVE 构建应用仍耗 Taskade 积分。key 失败时默认回退可能改耗 Taskade 积分；公开 Agent 及自动化路径有更窄规则。

切换工作负载前，应选择具体模型并检查模型方及 Taskade 两边用量。隐私政策中的不训练合同是处理条件，不证明内容仅在设备本地，也不证明模型输出准确。本次未创建、保存、测试或传送模型 key。

sections.title_en: Restoring a revision can change the live app
sections.title_zh: 恢复 revision 可能改变线上应用
sections.en:
The revisions guide distinguishes the builder’s Current Version from the Live revision. Restoring an unpublished app changes preview; manual publishing requires publishing the restored version; automatic publishing can put the restored revision live. That is app-version behavior, not a demonstrated rollback of all business records, credentials or external actions.

Paid GitHub/.tsk export includes app structures, projects, agents and automations, while secrets, custom domains and App Users need separate handling. Importing a GitHub bundle can automatically activate automations; destination plan and item limits apply. Rehearse with isolated data and disconnected external destinations. An exportable app is not a self-hosted copy of Taskade’s entire service.
sections.zh:
revision 指南区分构建器 Current Version 与线上 Live。恢复未发布应用会改变预览；手工发布模式需再发布恢复版；自动发布模式可能直接使恢复版上线。这是应用版本行为，不证明所有业务记录、凭据或外部动作回滚。

付费 GitHub／.tsk 导出包含应用结构、项目、Agent 和自动化；secret、自定义域名及 App Users 需另处理。导入 GitHub 包可能自动启用流程，并受目标方案及对象限制。应使用隔离数据、断开外部目标演练。应用可导出不等于自行托管整个 Taskade 服务。

sections.title_en: User content rights and platform rights stay distinct
sections.title_zh: 用户内容权利与平台权利保持区分
sections.en:
Terms retain user-content ownership and grant processing rights, with broader licenses for content deliberately published to community surfaces. Generated-app export does not grant the proprietary platform’s source rights. Published-app operators must handle their own users and data obligations; a generated sign-in page is not complete operational readiness.

Paid cancellation normally takes effect at cycle end with projects intact. Account termination is different: the terms may allow content deletion without a retention promise. Export before closing an account and validate the copy. A thirty-day billing-error review is not a universal refund promise. Actual exit, export completeness and independent service recovery were not tested.
sections.zh:
条款保留用户内容所有权并取得处理权；有意发布到社区的内容有更广许可。生成应用导出不授予专有平台源码权利。已发布应用运营者需处理自己的用户及数据义务，生成登录页不等于完整运营就绪。

付费取消通常周期末生效并保留项目。账户终止不同，条款可能允许删除内容而不承诺保留期。关闭前应导出并验证副本。三十天账单错误复核不是通用退款承诺。本次未测试实际退出、导出完整性或独立服务恢复。

seo.primary_intent: Evaluate task planning together with app and automation execution.
secondary_questions: Does importing an app activate its automations?
seo.query_basis: Editorial hypotheses; no measured demand or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No signup, app build/publish, project edit, role/link change, agent run, automation/retry, key/provider connection, export/import/restore or payment executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行注册、构建／发布应用、项目编辑、角色／链接修改、Agent 运行、自动化／重试、key／模型方连接、导出／导入／恢复或付款。

research_gaps.en: Exact region/currency/tax/checkout, per-action cost and daily request limits, top-up thresholds/prices, legacy entitlement and workflow-specific idempotency unverified. Published-runtime cost statements do not establish zero external/AI usage cost.
research_gaps.zh: 准确地区／币种／税／结账、逐动作费用及每日请求限制、充值阈值／价格、旧权益及具体流程幂等性未核实。已发布运行费用表述不确立外部／AI 用量零成本。

research_gaps.en: App revision versus data rollback, full bundle restoration, external connector parity, all current interface languages and regional model processing remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 应用 revision 与数据回滚差异、完整包恢复、外部连接器一致性、全部当前界面语言及地区模型处理未核实。
